##### Project general facts

Kyoto by ORO24 is a beautifully conceived residential tower that invites residents into a true sanctuary of calmness amid the energy of a thriving city. Inspired by the timeless serenity of Japanese zen gardens, the project weaves flowing water features, tranquil stone textures and lush greenery throughout its striking architecture. Thoughtfully designed apartments are arranged across the tower to offer residents a refined, peaceful, and elevated everyday living experience.

Kyoto by ORO24 delights residents with an extraordinary collection of amenities spread across four beautifully landscaped zones. Highlights include a stunning 40-meter infinity pool, a landscape pool deck, a dedicated kids' pool, a rooftop lounge, an observatory lounge, and an elegant party hall with sweeping city views. Wellness and leisure are equally celebrated through a fully equipped health club, a serene yoga deck, a meditation zone, rainforest dining, a business center, a library, and playful additions like padel on water, bowling, billiards, an arcade, virtual golf, and generous jogging tracks and gardens for the whole family to enjoy.

Every corner of Kyoto by ORO24 reflects a commitment to elegant, calming design and premium craftsmanship. Interiors welcome residents with warm timber tones, softly veined natural stone, and flowing water-inspired details that echo the project's zen philosophy from the grand entrance lobby to the tranquil lift lobbies. Carefully curated finishes throughout create a soothing, sophisticated atmosphere that makes every space feel like a peaceful retreat.

##### Location description and benefits

Arjan is a residential community located near the popular attractions of Dubai, such as the Dubai Miracle Garden and the Mall of the Emirates.

Arjan offers various amenities to its residents, including landscaped gardens, swimming pools, fitness centers, and retail outlets. It is a family-friendly community with a safe and secure environment. There are several schools, healthcare facilities, and supermarkets in the area, making it a convenient place to live.

The community also features several parks and playgrounds, providing residents with opportunities for outdoor activities and recreational opportunities. Arjan is well-connected to the rest of Dubai through the Dubai-Al Ain Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and the Al Khail Road, making it easy to access other parts of the city.
